title: Conformal welding of chord-arc curves
summary: We study the relation between the geometric properties of a chord-arc curve and its conformal welding. Let $h$ be the conformal welding of a closed quasicircle $Γ$. By Jones's theorem, the pull-back operator $C_h u=u\circ h$ is bounded on BMO if and only if $h$ corresponds to the welding of a Bishop-Jones quasicircle, equivalently, $h$ is strongly quasisymmetric. Let $A_h$ denote the analytic projection of $C_h$. We prove that $A_h$ is a bounded isomorphism on BMOA if and only if $Γ$ is a chord-arc curve.
